title: Novyse plugin manifest
description: Manifest shipped inside dist/manifest.json of every plugin bundle.

stateVersion.description: Version of the STATE payload format. A breaking change requires a new major version.

permissions.description: What the plugin needs beyond the sandbox defaults. Each grant asked here shows up in the install screen of the app.

frame.description: Origins the plugin loads into a frame, e.g. its video player. `https://host`, `https://host:port` or `https://*.host`: no path, no query, https only. A wildcard never covers the apex and must name a registrable domain, so `*.example.com` is fine and `*.com` is not. The client is the authority: an entry it rejects is dropped, never the plugin.
